name: stubble
description: Access your activity history, tasks, and projects from Stubble
long_description: Stubble tracks your work activity and generates AI-powered task summaries. This extension allows Claude to query your activity history, tasks, projects, and daily summaries to provide personalized assistance based on what you've been working on. Includes the /stubble skill for generating beautiful visual timesheets.

api_key.title: Stubble API Key
api_key.description: Your Stubble MCP API key. Find it in the Stubble app under Connect tab.
